output_list.reason: The 'distribute' function allows an attacker to overflow the totalSupply of the contract, allowing them to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens.
The 'transfer' function allows an attacker to overflow the balances of the contract, allowing them to transfer an arbitrary amount of tokens.

The 'approve' function allows an attacker to overflow the allowed amount, allowing them to approve an arbitrary amount of tokens.
